title: Task event
description: Published by the control plane to exchange tenant.tasks with routing key task.<type> when a task is accepted. The task is the event: AMQP message_id = id. Consumers must ignore unknown properties.

id.description: Task ID; the stable event ID consumers deduplicate on.

status.description: Always accepted: a task is published once, when it is created.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC with milliseconds and a Z suffix.
